note: Library revisions the fixtures and anchors were generated against. Revisions are provenance, not an install requirement; floors are the oldest versions that carry every interface the adapters call.

orbix.role: Keplerian orbits, Kepler solver, L2 halo orbit, keepout

photomancy.role: orbit prior with planet-scale sites (sample_planet_scale, unreleased after 0.4.0; installed in CI from the sibling pin at this revision until a release carries it)

skyscapes.role: Star, BlackbodyStar, FlatStar, Planet, System, LambertianPhysicalModel, from_phoenix, the occurrence-rate population draw (FlatStar.diameter_arcsec, from_phoenix and the population draw unreleased after 2.1.0; installed from the sibling pin at this revision until a release carries it)

yippy.role: pinned response package loader and response metadata (stellar_frame, stellar_pixel_scale_lod)

jaxedith.role: count rates and noise, QE applied once, fixed-frame variance and planners (unreleased after 2.0.0; installed from the sibling pin at this revision until a release carries it)

optixstuff.role: response density and core area, SimplePrimary.from_yip, dQE default 1.0 (unreleased after 4.0.1; installed from the sibling pin at this revision until a release carries it)

zodi.role: zodiacal and exozodiacal light: Leinert tables, the AYO default zodi color, and the exozodi flux ratio in the host star's color

catalog.query: select * from di_stars_exep where hip_name like 'HIP 53721%'
